limitations: Documentation command literals are parsed and the same positional forms run against owned synthetic sources through the production command function in the Pester host with OutputParent substituted. They do not process the illustrative D-drive folder, real Pictures or personal media, and do not establish a physical drag gesture.
Codec/version/JPEG dependency negatives include narrow controlled capability responses bound to a verified executable; they do not establish the behavior of every external build.
Desktop ordinary-account observations are separate from elevated hosted Windows Server checks. Windows 10 and live UNC/network shares remain untested/owner-excluded respectively.
Security reporting availability and unpublished release/tag state are dated repository API observations, not promises about future settings, contact addresses or support deadlines.

Version 1.0.0 remains unreleased and unsigned. Updated guide bytes are exercised in clean-revision package extraction tests; older M4-T02 ZIP hashes identify the older guide and are not relabeled as this revision.
Subjective quality/workflow acceptance stays bound to the earlier owner-accepted runtime. Merge/tag/release publication and website deployment require separate approval.
